purpose: Ancestor call unpack must reach an owning detached middle return without consuming it or entering the callee. Its array aliases a raw reference current; held/return counts survive later row COW and physical close with unique element edges.
source:
<?php
class ReviewChainOld30 { function __destruct() { echo "A|"; } }
class ReviewChainNew30 { function __destruct() { echo "B|"; } }
function &reviewChainChild30() { global $row; $row = [new ReviewChainOld30()]; echo "C|"; yield $row; echo "L|"; return $row; }
function reviewChainMiddle30() { try { echo "M|"; $answer = yield from $GLOBALS["child"]; echo "BAD-MIDDLE|"; } finally { echo "J|"; } }
function reviewChainOuter30() { try { echo "O|"; yield from $GLOBALS["middle"]; echo "BAD-OUTER|"; } finally { echo "F|"; } }
function reviewChainTarget30(...$arguments) { echo "BAD-CALLEE|"; }
$child = reviewChainChild30(); $middle = reviewChainMiddle30(); $outer = reviewChainOuter30();
echo "P|"; $outer->rewind(); $child->next(); $held = $outer->current(); echo "H|", $held[0] instanceof ReviewChainOld30 ? 1 : 0, "|"; unset($child); echo "T|";
try { reviewChainTarget30(...$outer); echo "BAD-RETURN|"; } catch (Error $error) { echo "K|", $error->getLine(), "|", $error->getPrevious() === null ? "NOPREV|" : "PREV|"; }
$row[0] = new ReviewChainNew30(); echo "W|", $held[0] instanceof ReviewChainOld30 ? 1 : 0, "|", $outer->current()[0] instanceof ReviewChainNew30 ? 1 : 0, "|"; unset($error); echo "EX|";
unset($outer); echo "OUT|"; unset($middle); echo "MID|"; unset($row); echo "ROW|"; unset($held); echo "HELD|"; echo "E";

purpose: A present-null cache and owning array with an embedded global reference sit below an unpacked native Generator ancestor. After actual unpack Error and physical close, rebinding the shared cell must update retained ownership and retire the old object before the write marker.

<?php
class ReviewChainCellOld30 { function __destruct() { echo "R|"; } }
class ReviewChainCellNew30 { function __destruct() { echo "CNEW|"; } }
function reviewChainCellChild30() { global $slot; echo "C|"; yield null; echo "L|"; $slot = new ReviewChainCellOld30(); return [&$slot]; }
function reviewChainCellMiddle30() { try { echo "M|"; $answer = yield from $GLOBALS["child"]; echo "BAD-MIDDLE|"; } finally { echo "J|"; } }
function reviewChainCellOuter30() { try { echo "O|"; yield from $GLOBALS["middle"]; echo "BAD-OUTER|"; } finally { echo "F|"; } }
function reviewChainCellTarget30(...$arguments) { echo "BAD-CALLEE|"; }
$child = reviewChainCellChild30(); $middle = reviewChainCellMiddle30(); $outer = reviewChainCellOuter30();
echo "P|"; $outer->rewind(); $child->next(); echo "H|", $outer->current() === null ? 1 : 0, "|"; unset($child); echo "T|";
try { reviewChainCellTarget30(...$outer); echo "BAD-RETURN|"; } catch (Error $error) { echo "K|", $error->getLine(), "|", $error->getPrevious() === null ? "NOPREV|" : "PREV|"; }
unset($error); echo "EX|"; unset($outer); echo "OUT|"; unset($middle); echo "MID|";
$slot = new ReviewChainCellNew30(); echo "WRITE|"; unset($slot); echo "UNSET|"; echo "E";
